title: 第19章 我儿子有讹圣之姿第20章 大哥 陈家未来靠你了
slug: 开局被退婚反手娶小姨子
lines: “不碍事。”
商应年捂着伤口，鲜血还是渗透，他丝毫不在意道：“不过是些许风霜罢了，对吧，红尘。”
商红尘发愣看着剑刃上的那一抹红色，她的剑刺穿了父亲的防御，伤害父亲。
这一刻，她是懵逼的。
“父亲，女儿不是故意的，我这就……”
“别，别过来，你站在原地别动，算为父求你了。”
商应年有些后怕宝贝女儿的剑，有些厉害，竟然可以破开他的真罡，那把剑，一看就知道不是普通武器，至少是法器级别。
商应年可不想再吃一剑，这种痛苦，尝试一次就够了，第二次，免了。
“你们两个要打就赶紧打，能不能不要把我扯进来，我是无辜的。”
商应年这句话是对陈初阳说的，这个小子太阴险了，再怎么说自己也是他的半个岳父，虽然女儿红尘退婚了，可不是还没彻底退成功，还差最后一步，这个小子竟然趁机报复。
赤果果的报复，商应年算是看出来了，这个小子并不像是他父亲那样单纯，充满了小心机。
是个阴险狡诈的小狐狸。
陈初阳同样也给商应年评价，这个老狐狸可不简单，竟然硬吃女儿一剑而没有任何反应，不愧为一家之主，这等忍耐，这等心性，这等城府，让人忌惮。
“陈初阳，放开我父亲，我饶你不死。”
“商红尘，我劝你还是放下剑吧，你也不希望你父亲有事吧？”
这句话一出，陈初阳不由得冒出了一个念头，难道我也要……
咳咳，我可不是这样的人，虽然这样做确实很爽，也可以狠狠踩商红尘的脸。
从某种角度而言，商红尘长得确实不错，不愧为龙蛇城的大美女。
“我什么我，商红尘，你只有一次机会哦。”
陈初阳按住了商应年，威胁商红尘，这一幕，看着有点……奇怪。
商红雪扶额，没眼看这个初阳哥哥，他果然还是那个他，这也太贱了。
那表情，那语气，那口吻，真的绝了。
商跃第一次看到这样子的陈初阳，眼睛瞪大，有些不敢置信。
“二姐，陈初阳他一直都是这样的人？”
商红雪苦涩摇头：“不是，他以前不是这样的。”
可能是后来变了吧。
嗯，很大可能。
或许是大姐退婚导致了他的这种改变，肯定是这样。
“我怎么看他这一招似乎用得很熟练。”
小胖子有些担心大姐，碰到这么一个无耻的人，会吃亏的。
content_en:
"It's out of the way."
Shang Yingnian covered the wound, but the blood still seeped through. He didn't care at all and said: "It's just a little bit of wind and frost, right, Hongchen."
Shang Hongchen stared blankly at the flash of red on the blade. Her sword pierced her father's defense and hurt him.
At this moment, she was confused.
"Father, my daughter didn't do it on purpose. I will..."
"No, don't come over. Just stand there and don't move. I'm begging you as a father."
Shang Yingnian was a little afraid of his precious daughter's sword, which was so powerful that it could break through his Zhen Gang. At a glance, it was clear that the sword was not an ordinary weapon, at least it was at the level of a magical weapon.
Shang Yingnian didn't want to take another blow from the sword. It was enough to try this kind of pain once. The second time was unnecessary.
"If you two want to fight, just do it quickly. Can you please don't involve me? I'm innocent."
Shang Yingnian said this to Chen Chuyang. This boy was too insidious. No matter how he said it, he was half his father-in-law. Although his daughter Hongchen had broken off the engagement, it was not that the divorce had not been completed completely. There was still one last step to go. This boy actually took the opportunity to take revenge.
Shang Yingnian finally saw Chi Guoguo's revenge. This boy was not as innocent as his father, but full of scheming.
He is a cunning little fox.
Chen Chuyang also commented on Shang Yingnian. This old fox is not simple. He actually took his daughter's sword without any reaction. He is worthy of being the head of the family. Such patience, such character, and such a palace are scary.
"Chen Chuyang, let go of my father and I will spare your life."
"Shang Hongchen, I advise you to put down your sword. You don't want anything to happen to your father, right?"
As soon as these words came out, Chen Chuyang couldn't help but have a thought, should I also...
Ahem, I'm not that kind of person, although it does feel good to do this, and it can also stomp on Shang Hongchen's face.
From a certain point of view, Shang Hongchen is really good-looking and deserves to be the beauty of Dragon and Snake City.
"You..."
"What am I, Shang Hongchen, you only have one chance."
Chen Chuyang held down Shang Yingnian and threatened Shang Hongchen. This scene looked a bit... strange.
Shang Hongxue held her forehead, unable to look at this brother Chuyang. He was still the same person. This was too cheap.
That expression, that tone, that tone, it's really amazing.
It was the first time that Shang Yue saw Chen Chuyang like this, his eyes widened in disbelief.
"Second sister, has Chen Chuyang always been like this?"
Shang Hongxue shook his head bitterly: "No, he wasn't like this before."
Maybe it changed later.
Well, very likely.
Perhaps it was his eldest sister's breakup of the engagement that caused this change in him, that was definitely the case.
"It seems to me that he uses this move very skillfully."
The little fat man was a little worried that his eldest sister would suffer a loss if she met such a shameless person.
